_status: ratified in part: email and organic social (Gate 2 call 1 b, 2026-10-18); paid and web held for Review 2
_note: HLR's content-type taxonomy (role type_registry_core). Ratified in part by Eddie on 2026-10-18 (Gate 2 call 1 b, DECISIONS): email and organic social are the copy engines' contract. Paid and web are ratified at Review 2 with the first masters; until then their rosters sit under `held_for_review_2`, a key the engine does not read, so paid briefs run on the engine's bundled ad types (paid-ad-copy references/ad-type-data.json) and say so, and web briefs wait (the engine ships no web roster to fall back to). Built 2026-10-18 by lane D from outputs/step-1-review/pattern-review.md, its addendum and patterns/*.md; nothing from memory. Tags: [observed] the live work shows it (node ids in the reference file LYyYXPDUHVoAABh865EvMI); [documented] the brand book states it (pN); [derived] our proposal, ratified where a status says so. `types` holds the email content types, keyed by id, because copy_lint.js and preflight.py read `types` as the email registry; organic social sits under `channels`. Email module ids (M##) are assigned by Chat 6 with brand-pack/slotmap.yaml, so `sections` names module jobs from the pattern review's skeleton (section 4.3), not module ids.

ratification.ruling: Gate 2 call 1 b: ratify email and social now, paid and web at Review 2 with the first masters; paid and web briefs fall back to the engine's generic roster meanwhile

paid._note: HLR's live paid roster (paid-ad-copy reads channels.paid; its ad-type-data.json is the engine fallback). Ids are HLR's own; `engine_type` names the engine type whose copy shape fits, or null where none does. In-frame copy fits the planned masters in slotmap_paid (brand-pack/slotmap-paid.yaml). [observed] no CTA is drawn in Meta art: the platform adds it.

types.label: Product hero
types.shape: One piece, cut out on a plain ground or inset on Alabaster: a caps eyebrow, the name in Saol, a caps subline. The product is the argument.
types.claims_exposure: low: names resolve through the product database

types.label: Offer
types.shape: The offer is the headline, over full-bleed photo or beside the product; a gift with purchase names what comes free and on what terms.
types.claims_exposure: offer terms: percent, code, threshold and dates are merge tokens until C10

types.label: Annotated piece
types.shape: The piece with one to four callouts on hairline leaders naming stones and materials; a build adds one callout per frame for motion.
types.claims_exposure: high: callout benefit lines ("BOOST INTUITION") are claims; every callout is a sourced fact or is not written

types.label: Stone or material meaning
types.shape: A material card (name and a one-line gloss) or a list of intention and stone pairs.
types.claims_exposure: high: meaning is a benefit claim (C2)

types.label: Birthstone grid
types.shape: Twelve months, each a tile with the piece, the month and the stone.
types.claims_exposure: tiles are data-fed (product database attributes.birth_month); any meaning line is tradition or intention wording, never a promised effect

types.label: Brand line
types.shape: One Saol line with one italic accent word over a model photo, or the wordmark as a masthead with a short line.
types.claims_exposure: positioning lines wait for C2 and C7 ("witch within", "healing journey")

types.label: Mantra
types.shape: A short affirmation alone on an image or a flat ground, or built word by word for motion.
types.claims_exposure: health-adjacent mantras ("In my healing era") wait for C2

types.label: Press quote
types.shape: A publication's words in Saol with its logo under them.
types.claims_exposure: verbatim and sourced; the publication's logo needs rights

types.label: Customer review
types.shape: One or two short customer quotes over customer imagery.
types.claims_exposure: verbatim and sourced in Judge.me; UGC imagery needs rights

types.label: DM reply
types.shape: A customer's message in a reply bubble over customer imagery.
types.claims_exposure: a real message, verbatim and sourced; a dramatised exchange is the engine's fake_thread and needs a disclosure

types.label: Link ad (Google formats)
types.shape: A photo with the product; the words live in the platform's headline and description fields.
types.platform_note: Ruled (Gate 2 call 1, Google a, Eddie, 2026-10-18): no overlaid copy and no drawn CTA; the words live in the platform's headline and description fields. Source: Google's responsive display guidance advises against text overlaid on images (support.google.com/google-ads/answer/9823397, read 2026-10-18). The drawn "Shop now" box on the live link ads (P-LAND) retires.

types.claims_exposure: a quote variant is verbatim and sourced
